description: Hosted MCP server for job-search automation: match a CV to live vacancies, tailor applications, answer screening questions, and track submissions.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http keywordise https://keywordise.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEYWORDISE_API_KEY"

notes: Bearer API keys are minted and revoked by the user through Keywordise.
initialize, ping, and tools/list are callable without a key; tool calls require a key.
Application-submit and answer-submit tools are marked destructive/open-world so clients can request confirmation.

clients: other Streamable HTTP MCP clients with custom header support

notes: Keywordise homepage and hosted MCP endpoint were reachable during maintainer review.
Hosted endpoint returned method-gated MCP status during review.

license: Proprietary hosted service. Free trial: 7 days and 27 applications, no card.
